hero.tagline: I turn data from the atmosphere and outer space into knowledge. I research atmospheric electricity and space weather, and build cloud data pipelines for intelligent systems.

stats.label: in research funding as a thesis student

about.title: From radar to the cloud.
about.lead: I hold a Bachelor's degree in Physical Sciences. My training exposed me to the challenge of managing large-scale databases at CIEASEST, which gave me a solid foundation in analysis and automation.
about.body: To overcome the limitations of local infrastructure, I now specialize in AWS to design and deploy robust data pipelines in the cloud. My goal is clear: for this infrastructure to feed future AI models and agents, building systems that act in real time on innovative solutions.

projects.title: Air quality analysis for early warning of dust storms through climate monitoring in Ica — 2023
projects.authors: Loayza R., Romero R., Buleje Y., Arroyo J., Euribe C.
projects.description: Winning project of the UNICA 2023 Scientific Research Contest, funded with approx. USD 16,000. Data analysis, Python, SQL, Power BI and a virtual machine were applied for climate monitoring and dust-storm early warning, resulting in the aireica.com platform.

projects.title: NASA Space Apps Challenge 2025 — Stellar Stories
projects.authors: Rubén M. Romero, Joseph P. Arroyo
projects.description: We created “Cori's Journey”, an interactive digital story following Cori — a personified coronal mass ejection — on its voyage to Earth. It illustrates the effects of solar activity: from auroras to its impact on GPS, satellites and power grids.

items.title: This portfolio
items.description: An interactive site with a WebGL particle universe that changes shape in every chapter, fluid animations and support for three languages.

Kept the HF Radar Transmission Station and related equipment (magnetometer and bistatic radar) operational at CIEASEST — the Research Center on Solar Activity and its Effects on Earth — at UNICA. Produced monthly incident reports in Excel used for planning and continuous improvement.

Kept the laboratory running through maintenance, repair and calibration of equipment. Managed the purchase of components, applied preventive maintenance and organized the inventory for efficient access.
